description: Implementation of WNMapView class handling map rendering, user interaction, and notifications in a game scenario editor.

classes.name: WNMapView
classes.description: Custom view class for rendering and interacting with the game map, handling drawing, mouse events, and notifications.

methods.name: acceptsFirstResponder
methods.description: Returns YES to allow the view to receive key events.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Enables mouse moved events when the view becomes first responder.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Disables mouse moved events when the view resigns first responder.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Initializes notification observers, cursor images, and tracking rects after loading from nib.

methods.name: initWithFrame:
methods.description: Initializes the view with a given frame.

methods.name: drawRect:
methods.description: Handles rendering of the map, terrain, units, and cursor based on zoom level and map state.

methods.name: drawAt:mapPoint:zoomed:
methods.description: Draws terrain and units at a specific point, considering zoom level.

methods.name: displayUnitsAtPoint:mapPoint:forDifficulty:
methods.description: Displays units of a specified difficulty at a given point.

methods.name: isFlipped
methods.description: Returns YES, indicating the coordinate system is flipped.

methods.name: mapTabSelected:
methods.description: Handles tab selection changes, updating tracking rects and responder status.

methods.name: mapRestoreTracking:
methods.description: Restores mouse tracking after certain notifications.

methods.name: mapChanged:
methods.description: Updates view size and redraws when the map changes.

methods.name: mouseDown:
methods.description: Handles mouse click events for terrain and unit placement or removal.

methods.name: mouseMoved:
methods.description: Tracks mouse movement, updates map info display, and posts notifications.

methods.name: mouseEntered:
methods.description: Handles mouse entering the view, updating responder status.

methods.name: mapInfo:
methods.description: Updates map info display elements based on notification data.
